title: US and European diplomats continue standoff over top Bosnia and Herzegovina post
summary:
European powers resist Trump administration’s pick for high representative after incumbent pushed out
Diplomats from the US and Europe have been unable to resolve their differences and agree on a new top international envoy in Bosnia and Herzegovina, in a standoff
which has become a transatlantic test of wills
over influence in the Balkans.
A meeting in Sarajevo to select a new high representative, a post with far-reaching powers, ended without a compromise, in a spat that has undermined western cohesion in the region in the Trump era.
